email.subject: Quick fix for Pulse Group Fitness's site
email.body:
Hi Omar,

I took a look at Pulse Group Fitness's website. Two things are likely costing you members: there are no hours listed anywhere, so people searching "gym near me open now" can't tell if you're open and just go to a competitor. The footer also still shows old info, which makes the site look abandoned to new visitors checking if you're a real, active business.

Both are quick fixes. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what I'd change, no obligation.

Worth a quick look?

Alex
